h1: I fix what McpStamp Check flags and submit your MCP server to four stores
lead: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and the MCP Registry each check different things. I find what blocks yours, fix it in your repo and file the listings. Fixed prices, paid upfront, and I start the next business day.

services.name: Readiness Audit
services.short: Every blocker for all four stores, in the order to fix them, with the code change for each.
services.price_note: Paid upfront. Report in 3 business days.
scope: I run McpStamp Check on your endpoint, then read the server by hand. OAuth flow, tool annotations, descriptions and error handling.
I hold it against the published rules of the Claude Directory, ChatGPT apps, Gemini Connected Apps and the MCP Registry.
you_get: A written fix list, ranked by store blocker, with a code snippet for each fix
Written answers to your follow-up questions by email for 14 days
services.cta_note: I start the next business day. The report comes by email within 3 business days of having your server URL.
services.credit: Buy Store Launch or a custom server within 30 days and the full $490 comes back to you, so the audit costs nothing extra if you go on.

services.name: Store Launch
services.short: I fix your server until it passes, write the listings and submit them. Four stores, one fixed price.
services.price_note: All 4 stores. Paid upfront. About 10 business days.
scope: Fixes in your repo until the server passes McpStamp Check and each store's published review list.
OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, PKCE and refresh tokens, where a store needs sign-in.
Tool annotations, titles, server instructions and tool descriptions a reviewer can follow.
Listings written and submitted from your store accounts to Claude, ChatGPT, the MCP Registry, and Gemini when your account has access.
you_get: Fixes as commits in your repository
Up to 2 review rounds, where I fix what reviewers ask and resubmit
A McpStamp report from before and after the fixes
services.price_compare: One store costs $1,900. All four cost $4,900, so the third and fourth store add $1,100 between them.
services.note: Gemini Connected Apps opened in preview on 28 Oct 2026, for US developers through a waitlist, with over 50 apps at launch (TechCrunch, 28 Oct 2026). If your account has no Gemini access when I finish, you get a Gemini-ready server and the submission pack, and you choose. I submit later at no charge, or I refund $900.
services.cta_note: Paid upfront. Work starts the next business day.
services.guarantee: No one can promise that a store approves a listing. Anthropic, OpenAI and Google each decide for themselves. What I do promise is up to 2 review rounds, where I fix what the reviewer asks and resubmit.

faq.q: Why do you take payment upfront?
faq.a: I work async and start the next business day, so paying upfront lets me start the moment you're ready, with no invoice to chase and no call to book. If I haven't started, you get a full refund. If you cancel later, you get back the part of the price for work not done.

faq.q: Can I talk to you first?
faq.a: I don't do calls. Email support@zovo.one with any question before you pay and I'll answer in writing. Everything after that happens by email too, so you have a record of every decision.

faq.q: How do I pay, and who am I paying?
faq.a: By card, through Stripe. I never see your card number. The seller is autom8 LLC, a company registered in Yerevan, Armenia, and our Terms set out your rights, refunds included.
Stripe emails a receipt when you pay. For an invoice with your company name, address and tax ID, email support@zovo.one and I'll send one for that payment.
Yes. You get a full refund if I haven't started the work. After I start, I refund the part of the price for work not done, pro rata. Email support@zovo.one with your receipt.

faq.q: Does the audit fee count toward a launch?
faq.a: Yes. Buy Store Launch or a custom server within 30 days of the audit, pay the usual price, and I refund the full $490 to your card.

Stripe confirms the payment and I'm notified at once. Work starts the next business day. My email asks for what I need, which is your server URL, repo access and, for Store Launch, who can submit from your store accounts. Delivery dates count from the day I have access.

faq.q: Can you promise the stores will accept my server?
faq.a: No. Anthropic reviews Claude connectors, OpenAI reviews ChatGPT apps (plugins), and Google reviews Gemini Connected Apps, each under its own rules. Store Launch includes up to 2 review rounds where I fix what reviewers ask and resubmit. Gemini submission also needs your account to have Connected Apps access (a US waitlist preview since 28 Oct 2026).

faq.q: How does the Care plan renew?
faq.a: It doesn't renew by itself. You pay $1,470 for 3 months upfront. Before the 3 months end, I email you a renewal link. Pay it and the plan goes on. Ignore it and the plan ends, with nothing charged.
Not on this page. I'd rather show work you can check. The merged pull requests and the MCP Registry listings above are public.
You do. It goes into your repository under the licence you choose.

faq.q: Are my data and credentials safe with you?
faq.a: I keep your code, data and credentials confidential, use them only for your job and delete them within 30 days of delivery. I can also build against a sample or a test account, so your real data never has to leave your side. Rotate any keys you gave me after handover.

final.h2: Fix it yourself, or hand it to me
text: The free check already lists every fix with the change to make. If your team has the time, do them yourself. That's a fine choice.
If you'd rather spend that time on your product, start with the audit. It's $490, I start the next business day, and the whole fee counts toward a launch within 30 days.
